name: What's the difference between gas and wood-burning fire pits?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between gas and wood-burning fire pits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gas offers instant push-button ignition, cleaner burn, no ash cleanup; wood provides traditional crackle and higher BTUs but requires chopping and storage.
